LOOK: Students and queer allies staged a protest in front of the CAS gate this afternoon to amplify the calls of the LGBTQIA+ community.

Incumbent USC Councilor Nuraini Nordin urged the immediate passage of the long-delayed SOGIE Equality Bill, citing how this manifests to the repressive university policies such as limiting dress codes and the refusal of the administration to acknowledge lived names. 

“Mas lalo itong pinapalala ng rehimeng US-Marcos sa pagpapatuloy ng mga kasunduang militar gaya ng VFA, EDCA, at Balikatan Exercises, na nagresulta sa pagpaslang ng transwoman na si Jennifer Laude,” Nordin added. 

Current CASSC Councilor Abraham Gaddi cited the recent killing of transwoman media professional Ali Macalintal, arguing that attacks on press freedom and queer advocates continue under Ferdinand Marcos Jr.'s regime.

The formations also called for the implementation of a comprehensive sexuality education program and demanded accountability from the perpetrators of gender-based violence and killings. 

#Pride2025
#VakLaban2025

data.raw_text: My vacation can’t come quick enough . I don’t care what any city says I will put Miami traffic up against any u.s city. I have been to every state in this country and over 20 different countries and the only place I have seen worse traffic than Miami is Bogota, Delhi , which is the worst in the world Mumbai or actually any Indian city. Maybe Manila  but Miami traffic is just brutal. I know we have Los Angeles  and New York and the traffic is insane but at least you have some form of infrastructure. We have no infrastructure in Miami for the roads, there are very little back roads. This video that I took we only have three lanes on the interstate here. Imagine LA only having three lanes on their main interstate. This intersection has a turnpike, I-95, a main highway and 826, and another road, all merging at the same place. Then they took one of the lanes and made it an express that charges you like 15 bucks to go  4 miles and you sit in traffic on that. The city is just the worst and they waited so late to actually start working on the roads. The city started blowing up about 10 years ago and they just started waiting until two years ago to start building roads. Instead of working on the streets, we decided to put a $800 million arch so it could look pretty downtown with a park. So much corruption down here. We also are building a brand new 40,000 plus soccer stadium basically in the Miami international  airport parking lot. Let’s think about how much of a great idea that is.

‘HUWAG NILANG SABIHING SILA AY TERORISTA’

Concepcion Empeño and Linda Cadapan took part in the protest action at the Department of Justice in Manila earlier today, June 26, for the International Day in Support of Victims of Torture. 

They have been looking for their respective daughters, Karen and Sherlyn, since 2006 when the butcherJovito Palparan launched an all-out assault on activists and the progressive movement under the command of then Pres. Arroyo.
